notes.title: Where’s My Hentai Deck & Where’s My Bara Deck – Now Available!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Where’s My Hentai Deck and Where’s My Bara Deck are officially released!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45453949/2a6e474e1ff13c2509674e02bcbf90faa7fc01d9.jpg
Where’s My Hentai Deck
A straight-themed hidden object game where you search for your lost hentai deck scattered around the house.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3515540/Wheres_my_Hentai_Deck

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45453949/29c4495e7dd6fc42ae5e43a2edebf110868164bf.jpg
Where’s My Bara Deck
A bara-themed version where you must find your bara deck, hidden in various spots.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520290/Wheres_my_Bara_Deck

Both games offer a fun and spicy hidden object experience!

We also want to sincerely apologize for forgetting to apply the initial launch discount for Where’s My Bara Deck. This was an oversight on our part, and we appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for your support! We hope you enjoy the games!

notes.title: Announcement: Where's My Hentai Deck?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258683/dca8c98b84b239f84b457ab8ecd095ee5557b6a5.png
https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3515540/extras/Wheres-My-Hentai-Deck.gif?t=1740166819

You've spent years collecting the rarest and most precious hentai cards… but now they’re gone! Someone scattered your beloved deck all over the house, and it’s up to you to find them all.


  Explore 3D environments and uncover hidden cards in the most unexpected places.
 Look under beds, behind furniture, and inside suspicious spots – they could be anywhere!
 Unlock spicy artwork and complete your lost deck as you recover each card.


Get ready for a fun, naughty, and surprising scavenger hunt! Can you reclaim your entire deck?


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3515540/Wheres_my_Hentai_Deck/?beta=0
